name: Comedy Nights with Kapil
description: Comedy Nights with Kapil is a comedy show which provides a distinctive take on the everyday life of a common man as the show explores the story of every household and how our common man Kapil is affected by the simplest issues in life around him.

videos.title: Kapil Introduces his Family
videos.overview: The very first episode of the India's greatest laughter show commences. Kapil introduces his family members. He interviews Dharmendra as his first celebrity.

videos.title: Kapil Sharma goes 'Ghanchakkar
videos.overview: Kapil begins with his stand up comedy on the topic of superstitions. Later on the show Emraan Hashmi and Vidya Balan promote their film' Ghanchakkar'.

videos.title: SRK and Deepika does lungi dance on CNWK
videos.overview: Shahrukh Khan accompanies Kapil on the stage and is later joined by Deepika Padukone and Rohit Shetty who promote their film 'Chennai Express'.

videos.title: SRK gets his 'Chennai Express' on CNWK station
videos.overview: Kapil talks about love and marriage to begin the show. Later, the cast of 'Chennai Express' joins him as they have the audience in splits.

videos.title: Kapil Sharma and his master con plan
videos.overview: Kapil and his family try to con the government and earn some money. In the second half Prabhu Deva and Girish Kumar promote their film 'Ramaiya Vastavaiya'.

videos.title: Dadi meets Huma and Nawazzudin
videos.overview: Kapil comes up with a plan to get money out of the police. Later, Kapil invites Nawazzudin Siddiqui and Huma Qureshi to join him on the show.

videos.title: Remembering India's history
videos.overview: Kapil begins the show by asking the audience if they are good with history. Arjun Rampal and Irfan Khan are welcomed to the show. Kapil's family members tickle their funny bone.

videos.title: The conman-relative
videos.overview: Kapil begins with mocking the unwanted guests at home followed by the visit of Dadi's brother, who turns out to be a conman. The audience is amused by the entry of 'Bajatey Raho' star cast.

videos.title: Time travel for Kapil Sharma
videos.overview: Kapil takes the audience back to his childhood days and shows them a glimpse of his family. Later, he invites the new age mother of Bollywood, Kirron Kher.

videos.title: Comedy beauty parlour?
videos.overview: Kapil's cousin Babli takes over the stage in his absence and brings along her parlour. Later, Kapil catches on and invites Tina Dutta and Avika Gor on stage.
